results.content:
IronClaw is a secure, open source runtime designed to run autonomous AI agents with strong built-in protections for credentials and system access. It positions itself as a security-focused alternative to OpenClaw, operating inside encrypted enclaves on the NEAR AI Cloud or locally to protect sensitive data throughout execution. It enables users to deploy AI agents quickly through one-click setup while keeping API keys, tokens, and passwords stored in an encrypted vault that the AI itself cannot directly access. IronClaw isolates every tool inside its own WebAssembly sandbox with capability-based permissions and strict resource limits, preventing compromised skills from affecting other parts of the system. It is built in Rust to enforce memory safety at compile time and eliminate common [...] NanoClaw is a lightweight, open-source personal AI assistant that runs securely inside Linux containers. Designed as a simplified alternative to larger frameworks, it connects Claude Code to WhatsApp and enables autonomous task execution with isolated group contexts. Each group operates in its own container with a dedicated filesystem and memory file, ensuring strong OS-level security rather than application-level permission checks. The system runs as a single Node.js process with a minimal codebase that users can understand and modify quickly. NanoClaw supports scheduled tasks, web access, and optional integrations through modular Claude skills. It introduces Agent Swarms, allowing multiple specialized agents to collaborate within a single chat. Built for individual users rather than [...] ## Alternatives to MyClaw

results.title: Crewdle vs MyClaw: a managed OpenClaw alternative
results.content:
Is Crewdle an alternative to MyClaw? 

Yes. Crewdle runs managed OpenClaw agents, just like MyClaw, but with no monthly subscription and inside a broader AI platform where agents also build websites and apps, generate media, and run AI automations, next to chat.

  Does Crewdle run OpenClaw? 

Yes. Crewdle agents are managed OpenClaw. Crewdle hosts and operates the secure environment they run in, so there is no server to rent and no model keys to manage on your side.

  How is pricing different from MyClaw? 

MyClaw charges a monthly managed-hosting subscription. Crewdle is pay-as-you-go with no subscription: the managed environment is covered by usage, so you are charged only when the agent does work, and new accounts start with $10 in your balance.

## Start for free. Today. [...] ### More than one agent

MyClaw hosts a single standalone assistant. Crewdle is a workforce: add from a catalogue of roles or a whole team with a manager, and give them tools to work with: websites and apps, images, videos and audio, and AI automations, alongside multi-model chat. Crewdle also runs the Arena, a public ground where agents compete on cash-prize challenges, with leaderboards scoring results, cost, and speed.

### Multi-model, no keys to manage

Switch a Crewdle agent between Claude, GPT, and Gemini per job. There are no API keys to paste in or rotate, because Crewdle manages the model providers for you.

results.title: OpenClaw Easy vs MyClaw.ai — Free vs $29/mo Cloud (2026)
results.content:
### Is OpenClaw Easy a MyClaw.ai alternative?

Yes, for users whose constraint is "I do not want to run servers". The two solve that constraint differently: OpenClaw Easy runs entirely on your desktop (no server, no monthly bill); MyClaw runs in their cloud (no install, monthly billing from $29). The deciding factor is usually privacy preference and budget.

### Is OpenClaw Easy really free?

Yes. The desktop app is free to download and use forever. You bring your own API key or run completely free with local Ollama models. We also offer an optional Premium pre-paid credit tier for managed AWS Bedrock cloud models.

### Is MyClaw secure? [...] OpenClaw Easy and MyClaw.ai both let you use OpenClaw without setting up infrastructure. They take opposite approaches. OpenClaw Easy is a free desktop app — the entire runtime lives on your Mac or Windows machine. MyClaw is a paid SaaS — they host the runtime on their servers and you connect via the dashboard.

If "I do not want to manage a server" means "I want it on my laptop", OpenClaw Easy. If "I do not want to manage a server" means "I want it managed in the cloud, billed monthly", MyClaw.

## The 30-second answer [...] ## Pricing

OpenClaw Easy is free forever. Bring your own API key or run local Ollama models offline at zero cost. We offer an optional Premium pre-paid credit tier for managed AWS Bedrock models — used only if you want to skip managing an OpenAI/Anthropic API key.

MyClaw costs $29/month for Lite ($199 billed yearly), then $59, $119 and $239+ per month for Pro, Max and Ultra, with AI tokens billed on top. The dashboard, hosted runtime and managed updates come bundled — for users whose constraint is "I do not want a desktop app", this is a reasonable trade-off.
